intro: Expanding Horizons is a diplomatic courier mission originating in Darkshore that links the night elven settlement of Auberdine directly with the human kingdom of Stormwind. Tasked by Thundris Windweaver, an adventurer carries official correspondence across the ocean to City Architect Baros Alexston to foster closer ties and trade between the two distant Alliance realms.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Auberdine is a humble place, adventurer. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.
Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can smell the sea on you, friend!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.
